"Use the substitution $u=2 x$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3 \pi}{4}} 2 \cos{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "fdf6518e-e8a4-59f1-9024-2dc25c55475a" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\pi\\x=\frac{3 \pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{3 \pi}{4}} 2 \cos{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\int_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u.
$$"] [:db/add "fdf6518e-e8a4-59f1-9024-2dc25c55475a" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "fdf6518e-e8a4-59f1-9024-2dc25c55475a" :question/answer-fields Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \cos{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "77949b95-c0b4-5835-9c69-635a354c01c4" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{6}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\\x=\frac{\pi}{3}&\Longrightarrow u=\pi\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \cos{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "77949b95-c0b4-5835-9c69-635a354c01c4" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "77949b95-c0b4-5835-9c69-635a354c01c4" :question/answer-fields "Use the substitution $u=3 x$. Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int \cos{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "e96a768a-8b82-51b7-a945-24730214a8a0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \cos{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "e96a768a-8b82-51b7-a945-24730214a8a0" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "e96a768a-8b82-51b7-a945-24730214a8a0" :question/answer-fields "ec2ea545-7705-5b75-bfb2-a127dac9549b"] [:db/ensure "e96a768a-8b82-51b7-a945-24730214a8a0" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "e96a768a-8b82-51b7-a945-24730214a8a0"] [:db/add "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939" :answer/id #uuid "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939"] [:db/add "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939" :answer/value "- \frac{\cos{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}}{4}"] [:db/ensure "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939" :answer/validate] [:db/add "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb" :answer-field/id #uuid "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb"] [:db/add "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb" :answer-field/choices "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939"] [:db/add "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb" :answer-field/correct "dd974687-5fe3-5eb5-b3e7-f18717cb0939"] [:db/ensure "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a" :question/id #uuid "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a"] [:db/add "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \sin{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \cos{\left(u \right)}+C$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=4.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \sin{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{\cos{\left(u \right)}}{4}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{\cos{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}}{4}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a" :question/answer-fields "0c6c0ae1-37a9-54de-9f9b-77c31a7073fb"] [:db/ensure "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "85d13d2d-f042-57af-a1a0-8e6f471f6d8a"] [:db/add "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969" :answer/id #uuid "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969"] [:db/add "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969" :answer/value "\frac{3}{4}"] [:db/ensure "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969" :answer/validate] [:db/add "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a" :answer-field/id #uuid "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a"] [:db/add "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a" :answer-field/choices "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969"] [:db/add "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a" :answer-field/correct "5871b02d-2bef-5fb1-865e-65aff4cc3969"] [:db/ensure "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d" :question/id #uuid "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d"] [:db/add "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 3 \cos{\left(4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=\sin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Endpoint values: $\sin{\left(\frac{3 \pi}{2} \right)}=-1,\quad \sin{\left(2 \pi \right)}=0$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=4.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{3 \pi}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=2 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 3 \cos{\left(4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[\frac{3 \sin{\left(u \right)}}{4}\right]_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi}=\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{3}{4}\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\frac{3}{4}.
$$"] [:db/add "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d" :question/answer-fields "866f3cb3-d08c-55fc-9741-2055767f7e3a"] [:db/ensure "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "e448a4d2-65fb-5da5-83af-e67ab30b203d"] [:db/add "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3" :answer/id #uuid "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3"] [:db/add "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3" :answer/value "\frac{3}{2}"] [:db/ensure "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3" :answer/validate] [:db/add "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c" :answer-field/id #uuid "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c"] [:db/add "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c" :answer-field/choices "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3"] [:db/add "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c" :answer-field/correct "21ace9e0-6bda-5c7f-ac52-9b7bae7dcbe3"] [:db/ensure "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed" :question/id #uuid "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed"] [:db/add "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 3 \sin{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \cos{\left(u \right)}+C$.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{4}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\pi\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 3 \sin{\left(2 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[- \frac{3 \cos{\left(u \right)}}{2}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}=\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\frac{3}{2}.
$$"] [:db/add "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed" :question/answer-fields "cc9a28eb-7848-5087-9875-b8382c66378c"] [:db/ensure "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "f85dd1a8-9614-5c1d-8fde-7f1192c68aed"] [:db/add "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6" :answer/id #uuid "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6"] [:db/add "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6" :answer/value "\sin{\left(4 x + 1 \right)}"] [:db/ensure "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6" :answer/validate] [:db/add "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e" :answer-field/id #uuid "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e"] [:db/add "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e" :answer-field/choices "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6"] [:db/add "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e" :answer-field/correct "06e86e62-b46c-53c0-b647-0a53dd840de6"] [:db/ensure "58cda100-a260-5e8e-be68-fde68d9e9f1e" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "2ecdfaa1-5bd9-5f81-b6e3-023e7b805d55" :question/id #uuid "2ecdfaa1-5bd9-5f81-b6e3-023e7b805d55"] [:db/add "2ecdfaa1-5bd9-5f81-b6e3-023e7b805d55" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "364c4cf3-af52-5e60-b60f-daba0a790be0" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x + 1$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 3 \sin{\left(2 x + 1 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{3 \cos{\left(u \right)}}{2}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "25bced4a-34ed-5c44-b898-2a6f8e96effe" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{3}&\Longrightarrow u=\pi\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{3}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 2 \cos{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{2}{3}\left(\int_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[\frac{2 \sin{\left(u \right)}}{3}\right]_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}=\left(- \frac{2}{3}\right)-\left(0\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
- \frac{2}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "25bced4a-34ed-5c44-b898-2a6f8e96effe" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "25bced4a-34ed-5c44-b898-2a6f8e96effe" :question/answer-fields "dcd96290-8241-5bb2-b355-d84f90a808e0"] [:db/ensure "25bced4a-34ed-5c44-b898-2a6f8e96effe" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "25bced4a-34ed-5c44-b898-2a6f8e96effe"] [:db/add "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678" :answer/id #uuid "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678"] [:db/add "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678" :answer/value "- \frac{4}{3}"] [:db/ensure "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678" :answer/validate] [:db/add "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c" :answer-field/id #uuid "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c"] [:db/add "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c" :answer-field/choices "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678"] [:db/add "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c" :answer-field/correct "021af31d-9874-5ae8-a272-4821d0e63678"] [:db/ensure "30b9da8d-548f-5899-b955-bc31acebc31c" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "50022ab1-a0ca-57a9-87be-133525d6d898" :question/id #uuid "50022ab1-a0ca-57a9-87be-133525d6d898"] [:db/add "50022ab1-a0ca-57a9-87be-133525d6d898" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "cce7215f-f09f-5bb0-8216-21c5515d0db7" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=- 3 x + 2 \pi$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=-3.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\Longrightarrow u=2 \pi\\x=\frac{\pi}{6}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\end{aligned}

The new bounds decrease. Keep this order when evaluating the antiderivative.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{6}} 4 \sin{\left(- 3 x + 2 \pi \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=- \frac{4}{3}\left(\int_{2 \pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}} \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[\frac{4 \cos{\left(u \right)}}{3}\right]_{2 \pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}=\left(0\right)-\left(\frac{4}{3}\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
- \frac{4}{3}.
$$"] [:db/add "cce7215f-f09f-5bb0-8216-21c5515d0db7" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "cce7215f-f09f-5bb0-8216-21c5515d0db7" :question/answer-fields "334999f2-0ee1-5d2c-a8b2-9f1cd538e034"] [:db/ensure "cce7215f-f09f-5bb0-8216-21c5515d0db7" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "cce7215f-f09f-5bb0-8216-21c5515d0db7"] [:db/add "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594" :answer/id #uuid "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594"] [:db/add "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594" :answer/value "- \sin{\left(1 - 4 x \right)}"] [:db/ensure "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594" :answer/validate] [:db/add "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872" :answer-field/id #uuid "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872"] [:db/add "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872" :answer-field/choices "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594"] [:db/add "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872" :answer-field/correct "2bd2ef87-461c-54e9-9cd4-436889993594"] [:db/ensure "7662edc2-84aa-5b07-a675-80237a70e872" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "04ed37b0-08bb-53bf-b3a9-2a83ea7f67cd" :question/id #uuid "04ed37b0-08bb-53bf-b3a9-2a83ea7f67cd"] [:db/add "04ed37b0-08bb-53bf-b3a9-2a83ea7f67cd" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

$$

$$

$$
1.

$$"] [:db/add "cc8aa811-99e1-5f7b-aa43-885740447191" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\\x=\frac{2 \pi}{3}&\Longrightarrow u=2 \pi\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}} \sin{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi} \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi} \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "cc8aa811-99e1-5f7b-aa43-885740447191" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "cc8aa811-99e1-5f7b-aa43-885740447191" :question/answer-fields $$

$$

$$

$$"] ["77949b95-c0b4-5835-9c69-635a354c01c4" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=3.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{6}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{\pi}{2}\\x=\frac{\pi}{3}&\Longrightarrow u=\pi\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{3}} \cos{\left(3 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] ["77949b95-c0b4-5835-9c69-635a354c01c4" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] ["77949b95-c0b4-5835-9c69-635a354c01c4" :question/answer-fields "d9e83ee0-4cee-5737-a67c-38a3c93a3e99"] Transform both bounds:

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
